checks: Real trusted clipboard: two rows/three columns, exact identifiers, keyboard whole-paste undo/redo and range copy; no auto-save
Filtered paste binds visible row IDs only; sorting before undo/redo never writes hidden rows or wrong positions
Shift-click rectangle, copy and clear in one transaction; contiguous typing and header edit undo together without removing row-history features
Unfiltered append/undo/redo preserves new row IDs, formula-like text and separately added columns
Out-of-view, extra-column and clipboard-byte limits reject entire paste; no partial values or auto-save
Deferred save keeps later paste dirty; failure/retry preserves values; explicit save/reopen retains quoted tabs/newlines and encoding/BOM/CRLF metadata (simulated native IPC)
Multiline cells cannot be flattened by a single-line edit; actual textarea edits retain uniform cell newline style and undo as one draft transaction
50,000-row actual page remains virtualized and 3,000-cell paste/undo meets the bounded 5s check

performance.environment: headless Chromium local, ordinary motion, virtual DOM; not a cross-machine benchmark
